verses.text: After Ehud died, Israel’s people went back to doing evil in Yahweh’s sight. ⚠️
So Yahweh handed them over to Jabin, Canaan’s king, who ruled from Hazor. Sisera, who lived in Harosheth of the Gentiles, was commander of Jabin’s army. 👑
Israel cried out to Yahweh. Sisera had 900 iron chariots and had brutally oppressed Israel for twenty years. ⚔️
At that time Deborah, a prophet and Lappidoth’s wife, was leading Israel as judge. 👩‍⚖️
She sat under Deborah’s palm tree between Ramah and Bethel in Ephraim’s hill country. Israel’s people came to her to settle their disputes. 🌴
She sent for Barak son of Abinoam at Kedesh in Naphtali and told him, ‘Yahweh, Israel’s God, has commanded you: “Go to Mount Tabor and take 10,000 men from Naphtali and Zebulun with you. 📣
‘“I’ll draw Sisera, Jabin’s army commander, to the Kishon River with his chariots and troops. I’ll hand him over to you.”’ ⚔️
Barak told her, ‘If you come with me, I’ll go. If you don’t, I’m not going.’ 🗣️
She answered, ‘I’ll go with you. But you won’t get the honor for this mission, because Yahweh will hand Sisera over to a woman.’ Then Deborah got up and went with Barak to Kedesh. ⚖️
Barak called Zebulun and Naphtali together at Kedesh. Ten thousand men followed him, and Deborah went up with them. 🛡️
Now Heber the Kenite had separated from the other Kenites, the descendants of Hobab, Moses’ brother-in-law. He had pitched his tent by the oak at Zaanannim near Kedesh. 🏕️
Sisera got word that Barak son of Abinoam had gone up Mount Tabor. 👂
Sisera gathered all his chariots—900 iron chariots—and all the troops with him from Harosheth of the Gentiles to the Kishon River. 🛞
Deborah told Barak, ‘Move! Today Yahweh has handed Sisera over to you. Hasn’t Yahweh gone ahead of you?’ So Barak came down from Mount Tabor with 10,000 men behind him. ⚔️
Yahweh threw Sisera, his chariots, and his whole army into confusion before Barak. They were struck down by the sword. Sisera jumped out of his chariot and ran on foot. 🏃
Barak chased the chariots and army all the way to Harosheth of the Gentiles. Sisera’s whole army fell by the sword; not one man was left. ⚔️
But Sisera ran on foot to the tent of Jael, Heber the Kenite’s wife, because Jabin king of Hazor was at peace with Heber’s household. 🏃
Jael went out to meet Sisera and said, ‘Come in, sir. Come in with me—don’t be afraid.’ He went into her tent, and she covered him with a rug. 🏕️
He asked her, ‘Please, give me a little water. I’m thirsty.’ She opened a container of milk, gave him a drink, and covered him again. 🥛
He told her, ‘Stand at the tent entrance. If anyone comes asking, “Is there a man here?” tell them, “No.”’ 🤫
Then Jael, Heber’s wife, took a tent peg and a hammer. She quietly went over to him and drove the peg through his temple into the ground. He was sleeping deeply; he fainted and died. ⚠️

Just then Barak came by, chasing Sisera. Jael went out to meet him and said, ‘Come, I’ll show you the man you’re looking for.’ He went in and found Sisera dead, with the tent peg through his temple. ⚔️
That day God brought Jabin, Canaan’s king, under Israel’s control. 🛡️
Israel kept getting stronger against Jabin, Canaan’s king, until they destroyed him. ⚔️
